title: [4.7, Master] Crash and rendering problem
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in 4.7.dev, master branch

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (7e3928f25) - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8157) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13420H (12 threads) - 15.63 GiB memory

### Issue description

I just rebased my branch and ran Godot. This just happened

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sbMsUAx1_RzGEsrRdPpolDDnIYUrftjx/view?usp=sharing (Toggle fullscreen is pressing)
